authors: King County GIS Center (Puget Sound regional orthophoto consortium)
title: Regional aerial orthoimagery acquisition specification and photo-centre index (ortho_image15c): LEAF-OFF spring acquisition, 88-participant consortium
source: King County GIS Data Catalog, www5.kingcounty.gov/sdc/
relevance: The consortium that produces our King County imagery specifies acquisition during LEAF-OFF season, free of snow and smoke - 2012 flown March-May explicitly 'with the intent of representing leaf-off conditions', 2015 acquired in spring. NAIP by contrast is flown at peak growing season, LEAF-ON. Our archive therefore mixes leaf-off and leaf-on imagery and nothing in the pipeline accounts for it. If the 2020 City of Edmonds acquisition follows the same regional practice, our ONE hand-labelled year was labelled on imagery in which deciduous crowns are bare - which would be a physical explanation for the conifer-only blind spot rather than a modelling failure. The photo-centre index layer also carries per-exposure ACQ_DATE and UTC_TIME fields, so the actual dates are recoverable rather than lost.
